newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds were sharply higher on Tuesday as markets followed the lead of U.S. Treasuries, which surged on latest U.S. economic data.
The June Confederate bond futures contract (Conf) got as high as 119.44 in late afternoon following release of U.S. durable goods and consumer confidence data.
It was the highest level for the June contract since it traded at 119.72 on March 17.
The short end of the market was little changed, with EuroSwiss futures ending only slightly higher.
One dealer following EuroSwiss said trade was quiet, but he saw chances for further gains if the Swiss franc appreciates.
French elections May 25 and June 1 have created some uncertainty in the run-up to European Economic and Monetary Union which could be positive for the Swiss franc, he said.

The Swiss franc tends to gain on EMU uncertainty, and the Swiss National Bank has said repeatedly that it would use its monetary policy if necessary to work against any too-strong Swiss franc appreciation.
The market was also trying to assess the outlook for Swiss domestic growth.
